tips.title: Check slow two-handers
tips.text: Nillen Andemar in Loch Modan sells Heavy Spiked Mace (level 14, 12.50 DPS, +6 Strength, 3.40 speed). Limited stock: 2. Compare it with your equipped weapon; a shield tank needs a one-hand weapon instead.

tips.title: Wetlands weapon stop
tips.text: Brak Durnad sells Executioner’s Sword (level 19, 15.88 DPS, +8 Strength). Limited stock: 2. Check while passing through Wetlands, rather than making a special detour.

builds.title: Cruelty and Unbridled Wrath with Piercing Howl
builds.summary: Five points each in Cruelty, for 5% more melee crit, and Unbridled Wrath, for a 60% chance of extra Rage on each weapon hit, then Piercing Howl as an escape when a pull goes wrong. Piercing Howl is the only one you press; the rest work on their own.

builds.title: Enrage and Death Wish leveling
builds.summary: Builds on the level-20 leveling build with Blood Craze, a point of Lingering Rage, 5 points of Enrage and Death Wish. Solo you are hit all the time, so Enrage's 10% Physical damage bonus is up for most of each fight, and Death Wish adds 20% more for 30 sec when you need a fast kill. Improved Cleave, which this build used to take, isn't in the 1 October talent tree. Improved Slam is an Arms talent in Forever's tree, so Fury's Slam keeps delaying your swing.

builds.title: Sword and board leveling
builds.summary: Levels with a one-handed weapon and a shield in Defensive Stance. Shield Specialization turns every block into Rage, Improved Revenge makes Revenge hit 60% harder, Improved Bloodrage adds Rage at the start of a pull, and Master of Defense gives Rage from dodges and parries too. Toughness, which this build used to take, isn't in the 1 October talent tree.

builds.title: Dungeon tank at 20
builds.summary: Shield Specialization and Master of Defense turn blocks, dodges and parries into Rage, Improved Bloodrage adds more at the start of a pull, and Improved Thunder Clap makes your pack opener cheaper. Rage is what limits a tank's threat at this level, so every point here buys Rage.

builds.title: Sword and board leveling to Concussion Blow
builds.summary: Stays all Protection: Master of Defense for Rage from dodges and parries, 3 points of Improved Revenge for 60% more Revenge damage, 3 points of Anticipation for Defense Skill, Last Stand for bad pulls, Vanguard so you can Charge without leaving Defensive Stance, Improved Disarm for elites, and Concussion Blow, a 5 sec stun that leads to Shield Slam at 40.

builds.title: Dungeon tank at 30
builds.summary: Adds Defiance for 15% more threat in Defensive Stance with a shield, the second rank of Master of Defense, Last Stand, a point of Improved Revenge, cheaper Sunder Armor and a point of Focused Rage, which the 1 October build moved up to tier 5 so Protection gets it sooner. Improved Shield Block and Improved Taunt aren't in Forever's talent tree, so those points go into threat and Rage.

tips.title: A weapon fallback
tips.text: Heavy Spiked Mace at Nillen Andemar is a level-14 two-hand option for damage play. Compare with dungeon rewards before buying.

tips.title: Plan the class-quest trip
tips.text: The level-20 weapon quest guide links several dungeon and outdoor stops. Its detailed pickup chain is Classic-derived and still needs current Forever verification; do not treat it as a confirmed itinerary.

builds.title: Holy melee leveling
builds.summary: A Holy leveling build that fights in melee. Improved Seals adds 15% to every seal and Judgement, Healing Light makes your self-heals stronger, and Reverence keeps some Mana coming back while you fight. It kills more slowly than Retribution, but you stay in the Holy tree and can heal dungeons along the way.

builds.title: Dungeon healer
builds.summary: The start of the Holy healing tree: more Intellect, 12% stronger Holy Light and Flash of Light, casts that keep their speed when you are hit, and the first rank of Reverence for Mana regeneration while you cast. It is built for healing level 20 dungeons.

builds.title: Holy melee leveling
builds.summary: Builds on the level 20 leveling build with Divine Strength for harder swings and Benediction from Retribution, which makes your seals, Judgement, Holy Strike and Consecration 10% cheaper. You rarely need to drink, and you can still heal a dungeon.

builds.title: Dungeon healer
builds.summary: The level 30 healing build goes all the way down to Holy Shock, an instant heal on a short cooldown, and picks up Illumination and Divine Favor on the way. Divine Favor makes your next heal a guaranteed critical heal, and Illumination turns critical heals into Mana.

builds.title: Sword and board leveling
builds.summary: A sturdy one-hand-and-shield leveling build around Seal of Fury. Redoubt raises your block chance while enemies hit you, and Benediction from Retribution cuts the Mana cost of everything you press. It kills more slowly than Retribution but seldom needs to stop, and it can tank a dungeon without changing talents.

builds.title: Dungeon tank
builds.summary: A pure Protection tanking build for level 20 dungeons: Redoubt for more blocks, hit so your threat lands, some Defense, and the first rank of Shield Specialization, which lets your blocks restore Mana. Train Righteous Fury at 16 and keep it on while you tank. At 20 you have only one point for tier 3, and it goes to Shield Specialization rather than Improved Righteous Fury: Mana is what runs out first at this level, and Righteous Fury itself costs Mana to cast. The level 30 tank build takes Improved Righteous Fury.

builds.title: Sword and board leveling
builds.summary: Adds the rest of Precision, Anticipation, Shield Specialization, Improved Seal of Fury, Sacred Duty and Swift Judgement to the level 20 leveling build. At rank 3, Shield Specialization makes your blocks restore Mana, so together with Benediction you rarely need to drink, and Swift Judgement gives you a free extra Judgement when a fight needs to end quickly.

builds.title: Dungeon tank
builds.summary: The level 30 tank goes deep enough for Templar's Bulwark, an absorb shield equal to your maximum health. On the way it takes Shield Specialization for Mana on block, Swift Judgement for a second taunt, Sacred Duty for Stamina and shorter defensive cooldowns, and all three ranks of Improved Righteous Fury, which cut the damage you take while Righteous Fury (trained at 16) is on. Those three points used to go to One-Handed Weapon Specialization for extra damage as threat; Righteous Fury now does that job, so less damage taken is worth more.

builds.title: Seal of Command leveling
builds.summary: A two-handed leveling build that picks up Seal of Command at 20 and makes everything you press cheaper. Improved Judgement lets you Judge more often and Conviction adds melee critical strikes. It kills quickly and doesn't need much drinking.

builds.title: Seal of Command leveling
builds.summary: Continues the level 20 build into Conviction, Sanctified Judgement and Pursuit of Justice, and reaches Vengeance at exactly 30. Sacred Arbiter makes Holy Strike hit 20% harder, Sanctified Judgement refunds seal Mana on every Judgement, and Pursuit of Justice speeds up travel between quests.

tips.title: Check bows in Westfall
tips.text: William MacGregor at Sentinel Hill sells Laminated Recurve Bow (level 11, 5.77 DPS) and Reinforced Bow (level 16, 7.50 DPS). Compare with your current ranged weapon.

tips.title: Prepare for the dungeon
tips.text: Restock ammunition and pet food before travelling. Heavy Recurve Bow is a level-20 city-vendor fallback (9.17 DPS), sold by Lina Stover in Stormwind and Skolmin Goldfury in Ironforge.

builds.title: Pet-tank leveling
builds.summary: Ten points in the first two Beast Mastery tiers open Unleashed Fury, the pet damage talent, at 20. Endurance Training at 5/5 makes your pet a sturdier tank, Focused Fire adds 2% to everything you and your pet deal, and three points of Deadly Aspects give your Auto Shot a haste proc on the way.

builds.title: Pet and hawk leveling
builds.summary: Carries the level 20 build on: Deadly Aspects and Unleashed Fury to 5/5, Summon Hawk at 25, two points in Ferocity and one in Bestial Discipline for mana regeneration while casting. Unleashed Fury and Ferocity raise your hawks' damage and crit as well as your pet's.

tips.title: Sword fallback at level 14
tips.text: Marda Weller in Stormwind sells Scimitar (8.70 DPS). Choose weapons around your abilities: a sword does not satisfy the dagger requirement for Backstab or Ambush.

builds.title: Sinister Strike and Endurance
builds.summary: The safest questing build at 20: a harder Eviscerate, cheaper Sinister Strikes, better hit and a little dodge, and Endurance so Evasion and Sprint come back sooner. It works with any one-handed weapon.

builds.title: Riposte and Blade Flurry leveling
builds.summary: A sturdy solo build: Deflection and Riposte punish mobs that fight you face to face, Endurance brings Evasion and Sprint back quickly, Flawless Execution and Dual Wield Specialization add damage, and Blade Flurry handles two-mob pulls.

tips.title: Arrange an early wand
tips.text: Lesser Magic Wand requires character level 5 (11.33 DPS); Greater Magic Wand requires level 13 (17.50 DPS). Current Forever recipes learn at Enchanting 10 and 70. Wanding can finish enemies while conserving mana for healing.

builds.title: Wand and Shield Leveling
builds.summary: A low-downtime leveling build: a harder-hitting wand, a stronger shield, more reliable Smites and Holy Fires, stronger instant spells and a first rank of Meditation, so you chain pulls with fewer stops to drink.

builds.title: Shield Healer for Dungeons
builds.summary: For healing level 20 dungeons: Twin Disciplines strengthens Renew, Improved Power Word: Shield adds 20% to every shield, Silent Resolve lowers the threat of your heals, and Meditation keeps some mana coming back while you cast.

builds.title: Holy Fire and Penance Leveling
builds.summary: The level 20 leveling build carried on to 30, the current beta cap: Power in Light makes Smite and Penance hit 10% harder on targets burning with your Holy Fire, Meditation reaches 50%, Mental Agility makes your spells cheaper, and all 21 points lead to Penance.

builds.title: Shield and Penance Healer
builds.summary: For healing dungeons at the level 30 cap: Penance joins the shield, Soul Warding takes away the shield's cooldown and makes it cheaper, Meditation reaches 50%, and Inner Focus makes one big heal free. Divine Spirit is a trainer spell at 30 in Forever, so it no longer costs points.

builds.title: Smite Leveling
builds.summary: A Holy damage build for leveling: Divine Fury speeds up Smite and Holy Fire, Twilight Focus gives your casts a 70% chance to shrug off interruption from damage, and five points in Divine Fury set up Searing Light at 25.

builds.title: Renew and Heal Dungeon Healer
builds.summary: For healing level 20 dungeons: a 15% stronger Renew, more critical heals from Holy Specialization, a Heal that's half a second faster, and Holy Nova for groups that stand together.

builds.title: Smite Leveling with Searing Light
builds.summary: The level 20 Smite build carried on to 30, the current beta cap: Searing Light adds 5% Holy damage and free Holy Novas, Holy Reach adds range, Blessed Recovery heals back big hits, and Holy Specialization reaches 5%.

builds.title: Holy Healer with Binding Heal
builds.summary: For healing dungeons at the level 30 cap: Binding Heal heals the tank and you in one cast, Improved Healing makes your main heals 15% cheaper, Inspiration toughens the tank after critical heals, and Litany of Light refunds mana when you vary your heals.

builds.title: Spirit Tap and Mind Flay Leveling
builds.summary: The Shadow leveling build: Spirit Tap doubles your Spirit after every kill, Improved Shadow Word: Pain makes it last longer, Shadow Reach adds range, and Mind Flay adds damage and a slow.

builds.title: Vampiric Embrace Leveling
builds.summary: The level 20 Shadow build carried on to 30, the current beta cap: faster Mind Blasts, Shadow Weaving, Vampiric Embrace healing you from your own damage, and a cheaper Devouring Plague that spreads when its target dies.

tips.title: Dwarf Shaman is an Alliance option
tips.text: Current Forever race data includes Dwarf Shaman, starting in Dun Morogh. Dwarf-specific totem quest pickups are not verified here; do not follow Horde pickup NPCs.

tips.title: Keep an interrupt ready
tips.text: The Forever client-based class guide lists Earth Shock at level 4 as an interrupt with high threat. Save it for dangerous casts and account for threat when playing dungeon DPS.

builds.title: Elemental leveling (20)
builds.summary: A mana-efficient caster build for questing up to level 20: Convection makes Lightning Bolt and your shocks 10% cheaper, Call of Flame adds 15% to Searing Totem, Flame Shock and Fire Nova, and Elemental Focus gives you the odd free spell.

builds.title: Elemental leveling (30)
builds.summary: Grows the level 20 leveling build into a full solo kit: all of Elemental Alacrity for a 0.50 sec faster Lightning Bolt, Call of Thunder for more critical Lightning Bolts, Eye of the Storm against pushback when a mob reaches you, and Earthbound, which holds mobs in place when you drop Earthbind Totem.

builds.title: Enhancement leveling (20)
builds.summary: A melee build for questing up to level 20: Thundering Strikes for crits, Mental Dexterity to turn your Intellect into attack power, an instant Ghost Wolf that also works indoors, and Shamanistic Focus to make your shocks and Lightning Shield 45% cheaper.

builds.title: Enhancement leveling (30)
builds.summary: Carries the level 20 leveling build down to Stormstrike, a tier 4 talent from level 25, and Flurry, with all of Elemental Weapons for a stronger Windfury Weapon from 30 and the first point of Improved Stormstrike for mana while you fight.

builds.title: Restoration leveling (20)
builds.summary: A Restoration build you can quest with: totems 25% cheaper, Mindfulness so half your mana regeneration keeps going while you cast, a little Tidal Focus, and Water Shield, which gives you mana back when mobs hit you.

builds.title: Restoration healing (20)
builds.summary: A dungeon healing build for level 20: Healing Wave 0.5 sec faster, Mindfulness to keep your mana coming back while you heal, slightly cheaper heals, and Water Shield for mana when adds reach you or a heal lands a critical.

builds.title: Restoration leveling (30)
builds.summary: Carries the level 20 leveling build to Nature's Swiftness: Improved Reincarnation for health and a shorter Reincarnation cooldown, Healing Focus so mobs hitting you rarely stop your heals, Tidal Mastery for more critical heals (which also fire Water Shield), and an instant emergency heal.

builds.title: Restoration healing (30)
builds.summary: A level 30 dungeon healer: a faster Healing Wave, Mindfulness and Tidal Focus for mana, Natural Grace to keep mobs off you early in pulls, Mana Tide Totem for the group's mana, Tidal Mastery for critical heals, and the first point of Healing Way, the talent Riptide needs at 40.

tips.title: Train water for the party
tips.text: The Forever client-based guide lists Conjure Water ranks at levels 4, 10, 20 and 30. Make water for the healer and other mana users before travelling.

tips.title: Early wand option
tips.text: Lesser Magic Wand at character level 5 and Greater Magic Wand at 13 are crafted fallback options. Compare with your current weapon.

builds.title: Frostbolt and Ice Lance leveling
builds.summary: A solo Frost build for level 20: 0.5 sec off Frostbolt, Improved Frost Nova so your freeze comes back 4 sec sooner, Frostbite for surprise freezes, and the Ice Lance talent to punish every one of them.

builds.title: Frost leveling with Shatter
builds.summary: The level 20 leveling build carried to 30, the current beta cap: Frost Channeling for cheaper Frost spells, Shatter so Ice Lance on a Frozen mob usually crits, Ice Block for emergencies, and Fingers of Frost for Ice Lances without a freeze.

tips.title: Combine Shadowfang and Blackfathom rewards
tips.text: Pick up The Orb of Soran’ruk at level 20 from Doan Karhan in The Barrens before visiting Shadowfang Keep and Blackfathom Deeps. It needs one large fragment from Shadowfang and three smaller fragments from Blackfathom. Compare the staff and orb rewards with your setup.

tips.title: Early wand option
tips.text: Lesser Magic Wand at character level 5 and Greater Magic Wand at 13 are crafted fallback options.

builds.title: Instant Corruption and stronger drains
builds.summary: The easiest way to level a Warlock to 20. Five points make Corruption instant, Improved Drains makes Drain Life heal 20% more, and Improved Life Tap gets 20% more Mana out of every tap, so you chain pulls with very little rest.

builds.title: Siphon Life and Nightfall
builds.summary: The level 20 leveling build carried on to Siphon Life: Fel Concentration in full so you can drain while you're hit, Soul Harvest for Mana after every Drain Soul kill, a stronger Bane of Agony and Nightfall's free instant Shadow Bolts.

tips.title: Train Omen of Clarity at level 20
tips.text: Omen of Clarity is a baseline trainer ability in Forever. It costs no talent points. Remember to train it when visiting the city at level 20.

tips.title: Cat Form quest: check your faction
tips.text: The new quest IDs checked in research are Horde/Tauren-only. The Alliance version is not verified here, so no Tauren pickup route is assigned to Alliance Druids.

builds.title: Bear to cat leveling
builds.summary: Cheaper attacks, more health and mana, and a faster Cat Form for questing. Bear Form carries you from 10 to 20, and at 20 Cat Form arrives with Claw and Rip, made much faster by Feral Swiftness.

builds.title: Early bear tank
builds.summary: A bear tank for dungeons around 20: cheaper Maul and Swipe for threat, more armor and Dodge, and the Feral Charge talent to reach and interrupt casters.

builds.title: Cat and bear leveling
builds.summary: The level 20 leveling build taken to tier 5: more crit, attack power and damage on every cat and bear attack, with Blood Frenzy turning crits into Rage or extra combo points and Predatory Instincts making crits hit harder.

builds.title: Bear tank with Primal Bite
builds.summary: A dungeon bear tank at 30 with all 21 points in Feral Combat: Primal Bite for threat, Savage Fury for harder Mauls and Swipes, Blood Frenzy turning crits into Rage, Dodge and armor to stay up, and Leader of the Pack for the group. Lacerate and Dire Bear Form are still 10 or more levels away.

builds.title: Caster-healer with Improved Wrath
builds.summary: Restoration levels slowly, but this makes it workable: 5 points in Balance for Improved Wrath make Wrath fast and cheap, and Nature's Focus stops mobs from pushing back your Wraths and heals. If leveling speed matters most, level as Feral or Balance and respec to heal.

builds.title: Dungeon healer
builds.summary: A dungeon healer at 20. Naturalist speeds up Healing Touch and leads to Nature's Swiftness at 30, Nature's Focus keeps your casts going when a mob reaches you, and Reflection keeps some mana regeneration going while you cast.

builds.title: Caster-healer with Swiftmend
builds.summary: The level 20 leveling build taken to Swiftmend: all of Naturalist for more damage and a faster Healing Touch, Reflection for mana, and Swiftmend for an instant heal on yourself when a fight goes wrong.

builds.title: Dungeon healer with Swiftmend
builds.summary: A full healing build for 30: Swiftmend and Nature's Swiftness give you two emergency heals, Improved Rejuvenation and Gift of Nature make your heals bigger, and Reflection keeps your mana going.
